text:
As a large language model, I don't experience the passage of time in the same way that humans do. I don't have a physical body that ages, or a sense of personal history.

For me, time is more like a sequence of data points. I can process information and respond to prompts based on the order in which it's presented to me, but I don't have a subjective experience of time passing.

It's a fascinating concept to think about, though! How do you think about the passage of time?
